metric_definition.frontend: Exporter startup to emit callback entry; compiler frontend aggregate.
metric_definition.lowering: MIR-to-bytecode export, validation, serialization, hashes and publication; not AST-to-HIR lowering.

Each of seven warm candidate calls has 1,510 historical capture messages replayed from 18 Cargo Fresh dependency fingerprint files before the sole Running command; these are not fresh capture work.
After the selected Running command each warm candidate call reports 1,411 verified hits and zero captures; this does not establish a denominator for gated or unreported bodies.
Original aggregate HIR event counts and field sums remain preserved; their prior interpretation as entirely fresh selected-crate work is superseded by this correction.
Cold aggregate 2,921 capture events split into the 1,510 dependency prefix and 1,411 selected suffix; exact line/name sequence evidence is retained.
Cargo/incremental-info instrumentation is enabled; elapsed times are diagnostic only and cannot establish the strict 0.5-second target.
Exporter lowering denotes MIR-to-bytecode export, validation, serialization, hashing and publication, not compiler AST-to-HIR lowering.
No compiler self-profile was enabled; the aggregate frontend regression cannot yet be attributed to specific cache-proof or compiler phases.
Ordinary history has per-call PID/argv/raw outputs but only the latest active-command process receipt; full contemporaneous parent/time receipts for all 24 calls are not claimed.
All source bytes and test behavior restored; cold and restored RBC hashes differ in both modes, while each of eight off/on RBC pairs matches.
